perspectives.name: discovery-weak-signals
observations: L3Harris disclosed an approximately $60 million U.S. Air Force contract on 2026-09-14 to continue DSU-43/B proximity-sensor production while expanding sensor production capacity.
The award follows a $4.7 billion seven-year PAC-3 propulsion award announced September 8, reinforcing a near-term pattern of munitions/sensor production demand rather than a single isolated win.

perspectives.name: expectations-execution
observations: Backlog and awards support demand visibility, but execution depends on converting capacity expansion into deliveries, margin and schedule performance.
Production ramp quality and working-capital/capex conversion remain more informative than award headlines alone.

sources.use: current production contract and capacity evidence

lineage.searchStrategy: fresh issuer primary-source acquisition focused on production conversion signals
